# Reactor
> Predict LinkedIn post performance before you publish. GO/WAIT/IMPROVE/NO verdict with an estimated impressions range.

## What is Reactor?
Reactor analyzes a LinkedIn post draft and predicts how it will perform using calibrated heuristics. Zero LLM calls — instant results.

## Quick start
Call the API directly — no install needed:
  curl -X POST https://reactor-api.keugenek.workers.dev/v1/predict -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"post":"Your LinkedIn post text","followers":1000}'

CLI (Node 18+):
  npx -y github:keugenek/reactor "Your post text" --followers 1000

MCP server (Claude Desktop / Cursor / Windsurf / Claude Code):
  { "mcpServers": { "reactor": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "github:keugenek/reactor", "--mcp"] } } }

Agent skill:
  npx skills add keugenek/reactor
  Full guide: skills/reactor/SKILL.md

## Limits
- Demo: 2 calls/day per IP (no key)
- Free: 5 calls/day (key from POST /v1/register, sent as Authorization: Bearer)
- /v1/predict and /v1/analyze-hook share the quota. Do not call them in a loop.

## API endpoints
Base URL: https://reactor-api.keugenek.workers.dev
OpenAPI: https://keugenek.github.io/reactor/openapi.json
- POST /v1/predict — predict post performance
- POST /v1/analyze-hook — analyze hook quality
- GET /v1/best-times — best posting hours (US Pacific)
- GET /v1/content-types — 18 content types with multipliers
- POST /v1/register — get a free API key (stores email + usage count; ask the user first)
- POST /v1/waitlist — join the Pro waitlist
- DELETE /v1/account — delete account
- GET /v1/health — health check
